about.title: About
about.text: I'm a full-stack developer based in Dhaka. I take products from an empty repo to production: the schema, the API, the interface, auth and deployment. So far that means school platforms, HR systems, travel portals and online stores, mostly with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL.

items.label: Building
items.text: At AdZoic: a newspaper platform, a social media management web app, ad creatives for SSP and DSP, dashboard features and ad engine configuration.

items.label: On the side
items.text: Still shipping for Arrowhead IT Solutions in my free time.

items.label: Studying
items.text: B.Sc. in CSE at The Institution of Engineers, Bangladesh.

projects.name: School Management Web App
projects.what: Everything a physical school runs on: classes, attendance, schedules, exams, a virtual classroom, progress reports and automatic class promotion. Students, parents, teachers and admins get role-based accounts, with built-in messaging and calling, payments, a chatbot and quizzes.
projects.hard: Building messaging, the text editor, quizzes and the chatbot in-house, integrating payments, shaping the architecture, and self-hosting the app and database on Coolify. I ran the full cycle.

projects.name: HR Management System
projects.what: Employee management, attendance, leave, show-cause notices, shifts, role-based access with page-level permissions, an analytics dashboard and report generation.
projects.hard: Pulling attendance from hardware devices, time zone and shift calculations, page-wise permissions, caching and revalidation, and PDF and Excel reports.

projects.name: Obokash.com
projects.what: Manages tours, visas, Hajj packages, flights and hotels, with section-by-section content feeding, form rules, comments, IP blocking and role-based access.
projects.hard: Tours and visas across many countries, blog comments with replies, section-based forms, and sending admin and user emails at the same time.

projects.name: Dynamic School Website
projects.what: One project that runs many school websites. Each institute gets its own admin, content editor and access rules, and new institutes are created from the dashboard.
projects.hard: Fetching data by domain, an architecture that serves many institutes at once, institute-level admin, and IP blocking on contact forms.

projects.name: Courier Management System
projects.what: Live tracking and dispatch on Google Maps, ETAs, route optimization, role-based portals with analytics, and invoices exported to PDF and CSV.
projects.hard: Real-time update conflicts, keeping notification state in sync, and role-based access across portals.

projects.name: ighotok.com
projects.what: A matrimonial platform with fully customizable search, favourites, proposals sent and received between members, and a match percentage for each profile.
projects.hard: Linking two members through the proposal flow, and the matching and suggestion logic. I handled database, frontend, backend, auth and deployment.

projects.name: BIRL E-Commerce
projects.what: A store with secure auth, product variant matrices with inventory, an analytics dashboard and secure checkout.
projects.hard: Keeping variant stock in sync, role-based access, and live orders alongside admin state.

more.text: Smaller builds: a quiz system, a video player, a text editor, a YouTube clone and a custom auth app.
